target_customer: Contract manufacturers and OEMs that hold excess electronic components or need to source chips quickly
problem: Hardware makers get stuck with excess chips when product plans change, and brokers pay low prices, while buyers in shortages face a counterfeit-heavy gray market. Mobius offers a vetted spot market with authenticity testing.
business_model: B2B marketplace taking a fee on trades of excess and in-demand electronic components, with authentication and an upcoming e-auction
product_category: B2B marketplace for electronic components and semiconductors

founders.name: Margaret Upshur
prior_employers: Particle (led operations, built a 40-person multinational team)
McKinsey (manufacturing consulting, helped open the Kenya office)
founders.background_notes: Per the YC company page. Richmond Biz Sense says she saw half a million dollars of excess material at a California electronics hardware company, which inspired the company.

technical_complexity.rationale: A marketplace plus a quality assurance process for authenticating chips; the company later built a machine-learning authentication system and filed a patent, but the 2020 version was largely marketplace engineering and operations.

defensibility.rationale: A marketplace needs liquidity on both sides and trust in authenticity, but brokers and other platforms could copy the model; the company claims 1,000 regular users by late 2025.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent is reported to have copied or bought Mobius through late 2025; sources name no specific rival.

market_need_then: In 2020 EMS firms and OEMs saw long lead times and shortages, and the founder cites her own half million dollars of excess chips written off at a prior employer while brokers and a counterfeit-heavy gray market were the alternatives.

branding.domain_note: Uses mobiusmaterials.com, not the bare mobius.com.

identity.logo: Not confirmed by any source opened
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, practical and trust-focused, with claims about savings, availability and tested authenticity

brand_strength.rationale: Only trade press and regional business coverage of funding rounds; no sourced evidence of community, merch or press about the brand itself. The site still had placeholder text in sections when fetched.

pivots.why: Per Richmond Biz Sense the company first tried recycling and pivoted to a marketplace in 2021; marketplace launched early 2022.

outcome_analysis: Mobius is active and small, with about 10 staff and over 1,000 regular users by late 2025. It pivoted from chip recycling to a marketplace, raised a 735 thousand dollar pre-seed in 2023 and a 3 million dollar seed in 2025. Shortages and tariffs have helped demand, but scale and liquidity are still unproven.
notes: Competitor search found no dated sources naming rivals around 2020, so the list is empty. Aggregators disagree on total raised (CB Insights 3.84M, others 3.0M or 3.7M), unverified. Richmond Biz Sense says 935K raised in investor funds and grants by 2023, of which 640K came from investors. A search summary credited Trolley Ventures with the 2023 round alongside Undeterred, not confirmed on the opened page. Crunchbase profile describes a different business.
